from solution import find_adverb_position


def test_issue_example_exact():
    """Example: find_adverb_position("clearly!! we can see the sky")==(0, 7, 'clearly')."""
    assert find_adverb_position("clearly!! we can see the sky") == (0, 7, "clearly")


def test_issue_start_at_zero():
    """Example start position is 0 for "clearly!! we can see the sky"."""
    result = find_adverb_position("clearly!! we can see the sky")
    assert result[0] == 0  # 'clearly' starts at index 0 = 0


def test_issue_end_at_seven():
    """Example end position is 7 for "clearly!! we can see the sky"."""
    result = find_adverb_position("clearly!! we can see the sky")
    assert result[1] == 7  # 0 + len('clearly') = 0 + 7 = 7


def test_issue_word_is_clearly():
    """Example adverb word is 'clearly' for "clearly!! we can see the sky"."""
    result = find_adverb_position("clearly!! we can see the sky")
    assert result[2] == "clearly"  # first word with len('clearly') = 7


def test_issue_slice_matches_word():
    """Positions locate the adverb since text[0:7] is 'clearly'."""
    text = "clearly!! we can see the sky"
    result = find_adverb_position(text)
    assert text[0:7] == result[2]  # text[0:7] has length 7 - 0 = 7


def test_issue_end_excludes_punctuation():
    """End 7 excludes trailing '!!' since text[7:9] is '!!'."""
    text = "clearly!! we can see the sky"
    result = find_adverb_position(text)
    assert text[7:9] == "!!"  # indices 7 + 2 = 9 give len('!!') = 2


def test_contract_is_callable():
    """Implement find_adverb_position in solution.py."""
    assert callable(find_adverb_position)


def test_contract_takes_text_parameter():
    """Implement find_adverb_position(text) in solution.py."""
    import inspect
    assert list(inspect.signature(find_adverb_position).parameters) == ["text"]


def test_contract_returns_triple():
    """Find all adverbs and their positions as a (start, end, word) triple."""
    result = find_adverb_position("clearly!! we can see the sky")
    assert len(result) == 3  # triple has length 2 + 1 = 3


def test_contract_positions_are_ints():
    """Find all adverbs and their positions with integer positions."""
    result = find_adverb_position("clearly!! we can see the sky")
    assert isinstance(result[0], int) and isinstance(result[1], int)


def test_contract_word_is_str():
    """Find all adverbs and their positions with string adverb."""
    result = find_adverb_position("clearly!! we can see the sky")
    assert isinstance(result[2], str)
